steps.action: On existing F-host run docs/chatgpt_status/topography/shards/height_difference_2/automation/030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1 only; preserve/start exactly one persistent canonical daemon and do not create a second runner.
Verify all four recovery/output receipts, persistent_daemon_count_after=1, fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim before canonical numeric work.
Resolve National LIDAR lineage for TQ3595, TQ5090 and TQ2570 from the exact returned catalogue features; record survey id, DTM filename, first/last flight dates, resolution, phase/latest state.

Resolve Time Stamped DTM lineage by exact native EPSG:27700 target point/polygon intersection; record only returned flight dates, resolution, transform and geoid. Do not infer these from another survey or tile-name granularity.

Use an XML-capable client on the official persistent Composite DTM 1m WCS GetCapabilities endpoint; record the real CoverageId, supported CRS/format and then DescribeCoverage before GetCoverage. Never guess CoverageId.

Retrieve actual EA DTM1m raster bytes for the bounded native HMLR EPSG:27700 polygons; exclude NoData -3.4028235e+38; compute median, q1, q3, min and max only from real pixels inside polygon. Do not use WMS imagery or centroid fallback for promotion.
Discover/download OS Terrain50 using current productId Terrain50 and area=TQ. Require real JSON/download/archive bytes and observed TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 members before crosscheck.
Read each downloaded Terrain50 tile metadata for CRS/datum/flying dates/lineage; sample documented pixel centres only. Treat 4m RMSE as product-level secondary accuracy, not parcel confidence.

Run three EA/OS numeric crosschecks, retain EA DTM1m as primary, perform human review and verify port 8012 readback. Mark manual action RESOLVED only after all recovery receipts plus fresh heartbeat/claim and output acceptance are remotely verified.
